messages.author: e6d426c9552b1af9
messages.subject: how to run the Shiny Leaflet demo?
parts:
Hi,

I was wondering how to run the Shiny Leaflet demo? It's available at http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/showcase/

The code is at github: https://github.com/jcheng5/leaflet-shiny

When I use runApp() on the code in https://github.com/jcheng5/leaflet-shiny/tree/master/inst/example it complains that it doesn't have the leaflet and ShinyDash library.

I did notice a leaflet.R file in https://github.com/jcheng5/leaflet-shiny/tree/master/R, while the ShinyDash supposedly can be installed via devtools::install_github("ShinyDash", "trestletech")

However, my installation of ShinyDash fails :-(
 
Error : object 'validateCssUnit' is not exported by 'namespace:shiny'
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package 'ShinyDash'


Does anyone have a clue on how to fix this? Many thanks! R session info below...

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: how to run the Shiny Leaflet demo?
parts:
The latest version of Shiny (0.7.0) exports that function. It just recently got on CRAN, and there aren't binary packages yet for Windows and Mac. But you should be able to install with:
  install.packages('shiny', type = 'source')
Or you can install from github:
  devtools::install_github('shiny')

-Winston

messages.subject: Re: how to run the Shiny Leaflet demo?
parts:
Hi,

thanks! that was fast :-) After I posted it I did notice I used the wrong shiny version. Indeed after updating I was able to install shinyDash.

However, the example still doesn't run :-( It seems I have some problems with certain paths:

In order to run the example on my windows machine I copied your code at github into a directory called Leaflet, set my R working directory to Leaflet\inst\example and try to use runApp()

In the server.R script I added a line to get the leaflet.R code and to get the uspop2000 data, also a line was added in the ui.R script to get the leaflet.R code as both scripts had library(leaflet) in it.

###server.R

...
source("C:/Users/hsontrop/Desktop/Shiny/Leaflet/R/leaflet.R")
load("C:/Users/hsontrop/Desktop/Shiny/Leaflet/data/uspop2000.RData")

...

When I use runApp() I now get a different error: 

Error in normalizePath(path.expand(path), winslash, mustWork) : 
path[1]="": De syntaxis van de bestandsnaam, mapnaam of volumenaam is onjuis

Is this how I should run the example on a windows machine?

ps: I'm Dutch, the last line in red reads something like "the syntax of the filename, mapname or volumename is incorrect"

-Winston

messages.subject: Re: how to run the Shiny Leaflet demo?
parts:
The leaflet-shiny repository is itself a package. So you need to install it first:

devtools::install_github("leaflet-shiny", "jcheng5")

Then your original runApp call should work fine.
